summary: Dustin Beaver, 33, and his 8-year-old daughter and 6-year-old child became lost in the Weminuche Wilderness after following bad directions from a Texas hiker toward Dollar Lake; a 30-person, two-helicopter SAR effort mobilized Monday morning; the family encountered an Australian family and walked out ~8 p.m. Monday uninjured; properly equipped, they started a fire each night
notes: UN story opened run 448 (Denver Post original via UN link); Saturday start = 2016-07-16 (Saturday-verified), SAR mobilized and family found Monday 2016-07-18. Zero Weminuche/Dollar Lake/Beaver rows + zero La Plata rows 2016-07-10--22.
